_about: 한국어 움직임·카메라 용어 → 영상 모델이 따르는 영어 표현 + 프레임 비교로 확인 가능한 검증 질문. aliases 중 하나가 요청 문장에 들어 있으면 매칭. 매장/현장 고유 표현은 여기에 추가하세요.

terms.en: slow dolly-in toward the main subject

check.question: Does the main subject appear larger in the last frame than in the first frame?

terms.en: slow dolly-out (pull back) revealing more of the scene

check.question: Does the main subject appear smaller, with more surroundings visible, in the last frame than in the first?

terms.en: camera pans slowly to the left

check.question: Has the view shifted so that content previously at the left edge is now nearer the center in the last frame?

terms.en: camera pans slowly to the right

check.question: Has the view shifted so that content previously at the right edge is now nearer the center in the last frame?

terms.en: camera tilts up slowly

check.question: Does the last frame show more of the upper part of the scene than the first frame?

terms.en: camera tilts down slowly

check.question: Does the last frame show more of the lower part of the scene than the first frame?

terms.en: camera orbits slowly around the subject

check.question: Is the subject seen from a noticeably different side angle in the last frame than in the first?

terms.en: tracking shot, the camera follows the subject keeping it centered

check.question: Does the subject stay roughly centered in frame while the background moves?

terms.en: static camera, locked-off tripod shot

check.question: Do static background elements stay in the same position across all frames?

terms.en: handheld camera with gentle natural shake

check.question: Does the framing shift slightly from frame to frame as if handheld?

terms.en: aerial drone shot gliding forward above the scene

check.question: Does the view move forward over the scene from a high vantage point?

terms.en: slow motion, movements are smooth and slowed down

check.question: Is the motion smooth and slow, with only small changes between adjacent frames?

terms.en: time-lapse, clouds and light change quickly

check.question: Do clouds, shadows or light change noticeably between the first and last frame?

terms.en: the person blinks naturally

check.question: Are the person's eyes closed or half-closed in at least one frame while open in others?

terms.en: the person gradually breaks into a gentle smile

check.question: Is the person smiling more in the last frame than in the first?

terms.en: the person slowly turns their head

check.question: Is the person's head turned to a different direction in the last frame than in the first?

terms.en: the person raises a hand and waves

check.question: Is the person's hand raised in a waving position in at least one frame?

terms.en: the subject walks forward with natural alternating steps

check.question: Has the subject's position changed between the first and last frame in a way consistent with walking?

terms.en: a gentle breeze moves hair, clothes and leaves in the same direction

check.question: Do hair, fabric or leaves visibly move between frames, in a consistent direction?

terms.en: the water surface ripples and flows naturally

check.question: Does the water surface pattern change between frames?

terms.en: thin smoke or steam rises and drifts upward

check.question: Is there smoke or steam whose shape changes and rises across frames?

terms.en: rain or snow falls steadily from top to bottom

check.question: Are falling raindrops or snowflakes visible?

terms.en: the flame flickers softly

check.question: Does the flame change shape between frames?

terms.en: clouds drift slowly across the sky

check.question: Have the clouds moved position between the first and last frame?

terms.en: the lighting gradually changes over the clip

check.question: Is the overall lighting or color temperature clearly different in the last frame than in the first?
